title: 第二百三十九章 引动天劫惊九霄第二百三十八章 月婵遥祝盼重逢
content_zh:
;;
月婵留下的那块碑，在身后越来越远。
楚夜没有回头。
但他知道，那道银白色的光，一直亮着。
像一盏灯。
等他回去的灯。
——
雾海深处，有什么东西在等着他。
他能感觉到。
那股气息，很熟悉。
三万年前，他在众生殿第二关的幻境里见过。
那个握着断剑的瞎眼老人。
那个斩向苍穹万里伤口的背影。
那个——灵溪宗祖师。
——
雾散了。
不是慢慢散。
是突然消失。
像有人掀开了一层纱。
楚夜站在一片虚空中。

脚下什么都没有。
头顶什么都没有。
四周什么都没有。
只有一个人。
站在他面前三丈外。
那人背对着他。
穿着一件洗得发白的麻衣。
腰间悬着一柄断剑。
和幻境里一模一样。
——
那人转过身。
不是瞎眼老人。
是——
楚夜愣住。
那张脸，他太熟悉了。
每天照镜子的时候，都能看见。
是他自己。
——
“又见面了。”那个自己开口。
声音也和他一模一样。

楚夜看着他。
content_en:
;;
The monument left by Yuechan is getting farther and farther behind.
Chu Ye didn't look back.
But he knew that the silvery white light was always on.
Like a light.
The light waiting for him to return.
——
Deep in the fog, something was waiting for him.
He can feel it.
That smell is very familiar.
Thirty thousand years ago, he saw it in the illusion of the second level of the Hall of All Living Beings.
The blind old man holding the broken sword.
The figure from the back slashing into the sky with wounds thousands of miles away.
That—the Patriarch of the Lingxi Sect.
——
The fog cleared.
It's not slowly spreading.
It disappeared suddenly.
It's like someone lifted a veil.
Chu Ye stood in the void.
There is nothing underfoot.
There is nothing above the head.
There was nothing around.
There is only one person.
Standing three feet away in front of him.
The man's back was turned to him.
Wearing a linen garment that has been washed white.
A broken sword hung from his waist.
Exactly the same as in the fantasy.
——
The man turned around.
Not a blind old man.
Yes——
Chu Ye was stunned.
That face was too familiar to him.
You can see it every day when you look in the mirror.
It's him.
——
"We meet again." The other person said.
The voice was exactly the same as his.
Chu Ye looked at him.
